purpose.domain_detail: Brazilian lottery (Loteria) simulation - user picks 6-10 numbers from 1-60, program randomly draws 6 numbers and counts attempts until they match
purpose.summary: A lottery simulation program where the user bets 6 to 10 numbers between 1 and 60. The program then repeatedly draws 6 random numbers using FUNCTION RANDOM seeded from the system clock until all 6 drawn numbers match the user's bet, counting the number of attempts and tracking elapsed time.

notable_features: FUNCTION RANDOM for random number generation
ACCEPT FROM TIME for clock-based seeding
88-level condition names used as boolean flags
Screen positioning with AT row/col in DISPLAY/ACCEPT
EVALUATE with numeric comparisons for bet size selection
verdict.notes: Source truncated at 16000 chars; the verification section (verificacao) and finalization logic are not visible but the overall structure is clear. File decoded as latin-1 due to Portuguese accented characters in comments. The program has a potential infinite loop design (repeating until random draw matches bet) which is characteristic of a student exercise rather than production code.
